scope: Complete per-glyph Korean dictionary order, direction, boundary and form crosscheck. Not exam-body certification.

entries.notes: 口 three matches, but the dictionary writes the top of 眞 as 匕 (a flat 丿 drawn from the upper right, 4, and a hooked 乚, 5) where the licensed MM original draws 真 with 十 (a long bar crossed by a vertical). Order and direction cannot bridge the form difference, so the glyph is held, as 贖 and 猜 were for 賣 and 靑. 目, the bar and 八 (6-13) agree

The 丿, fold and bottom bar of the left component and 关 (5-10, apart from the 丷 direction) sit in the same order, but the dictionary writes the two interior marks of the left 月 as dots descending to the lower right (3-4) where the licensed MM original draws two horizontal bars. Order and direction cannot bridge the form difference, so the glyph is held, as 揄·癒·諭·愉 were for the 月 of 兪
